purpose: Every source-text contract case in this application, with an owner and a disposition. These cases assert literal substrings of production source, so each migration increment that rewrites a pinned method body must take on rewriting the cases it breaks. Without this inventory those breakages arrive as rolling surprises and the suite cannot be used as a phase exit gate.
rules: A case is never mass-edited to green. Each is rewritten by the increment that breaks it.
A red case is a finding until an owner dispositions it; it is not noise.
status values: unmeasured | green | red. disposition: rewrite-with-increment | keep | retire | unknown.
These are the only App-layer coverage NeversoftMultitool has, because its test project targets net10.0 while App/** compiles only into the Windows target.
